chapter_seo_title: Xiao Chen Divinizes Eight Acupoints and Vows to Fight Ten Strongest
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen consumes a heavenly five-colored ginseng, divinizes three more acupoints, and hardens his body. He then declares a terrifying campaign of ten life-or-death battles against the top young experts of the Eternal Continent.
og_title: Eight Acupoints Divinized & the Declaration of Ten Battles
og_description: A heavenly treasure triggers an unprecedented acupoint breakthrough, and Xiao Chen resolves to challenge the strongest cultivators in a desperate bid to reach the Spirit-Treasury realm.
